title: AggregationSpecificationEnum
description: The potential options for specifying whether mark to market value of collateral is determined on an aggregated or loan by loan basis.

oneOf.title: Aggregated
oneOf.description: The market value is determined on an aggregated basis.

oneOf.title: AggregatedAndLoanByLoan
oneOf.description: The market value is determined on an aggregated basis for some loans but on a Loan by Loan basis for others.

oneOf.title: LoanByLoan
oneOf.description: The market value is determined on a loan by loan basis.

oneOf.title: NotSpecified
oneOf.description: It is not specified how the market value is determined.
